claim: Cenacolo Vinciano (Last Supper) is open Tue-Sun 8:15-19:00 (last admission 18:45), closed Mondays, Jan 1, Dec 25; full ticket €15, reduced 18-25 €2, under 18 free; visit limited to 15 minutes for groups of max 40 people; reservation required for all (even infants).
quote: Tuesday through Sunday: 8:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. (with last admission at 6:45 p.m.). [...] Full admission (25+): €15.00 [...] For conservation reasons visit the visits last 15 minutes for a maximum number of 40 people at a time.

claim: Last Supper tickets for May–August 2026 went on sale Tuesday March 24, 2026 at noon; tickets released quarterly with additional weekly drops every Wednesday at 12:00 for the following week.
quote: Admissions for May–August 2026 will go on sale Tuesday, March 24 at 12:00 p.m [...] Every Wednesday, at 12:00 noon, additional tickets for the following week are released for sale (exclusively online).

claim: On 3 April 2026, all entry-only Last Supper tickets through July were already sold out; guided-tour inventory remains a separate allocation often available when general admission is gone.
quote: On 3 April 2026, all entry-only tickets until July were already sold out, though tickets were still available for most days in August, while tickets for official tours were still available most days in July and August.

claim: Duomo di Milano 2026 ticket tiers: Duomo+Museum €10, Cathedral-only €8 (Wed only when museum closed), Culture Pass €15; rooftop-only €16 stairs / €18-28 lift; combo with rooftop from €22 stairs.
quote: Duomo+Museum (the interior of the church and the cathedral museum) costs €10 in 2026 [...] Rooftop-only access costs €16 for stairs and €18 to €28 for lift access.

claim: Duomo rooftop terraces open daily 8:00-19:00 with last entry 18:10; rooftop tickets sell out fastest April-October and on weekends.
quote: The Duomo di Milano rooftop opens from 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. with the last entry at 6:10 p.m. all seven days of the week.

claim: Museo Teatrale alla Scala open daily 9:30-17:30 (last entry 17:00); museum-only entry €12 fixed-date or €15 open/fast-track; guided theatre tour adds 60-90 minutes; quietest Mon/Tue mornings.
quote: The Museo Teatrale alla Scala charges €12 for a fixed-date entry ticket, or €15 for an open (flexible-date, fast-track) ticket. [...] The museum is open daily 9:30 am–5:30 pm (last admission 5:00 pm).

claim: La Scala's official 60-minute guided theatre tour costs €35 per person (no reductions), runs Mon-Sat subject to rehearsals/performances, and includes the Toscanini Ridotto, historic boxes, Royal Box and foyer; schedule released monthly on the 25th.
quote: €35 per person for the guided theater tour [...] admission to the Museum and a guided tour of the Theatre, including the A. Toscanini Ridotto, the historic boxes with their period decorations, the Royal Box, and the entrance foyer

claim: Castello Sforzesco museums open Tue-Sun 10:00-17:30 (last entry 17:00), closed Mondays; courtyard free and open 7:00-19:30 summer / 7:00-18:00 winter; museum ticket €5 full / €3 reduced; free entry Tuesdays after 14:00 and first Sunday monthly.
quote: Tue-Sun: 10am-5.30pm (last entry 5pm) [...] Standard admission: €5 (full price) [...] Every Tuesday after 2pm.

claim: Pinacoteca di Brera Grande Brera combined ticket (Pinacoteca + Palazzo Citterio, valid same day + 6 days) costs €20 full / €4 reduced (EU 18-25); under 18 free; first Sunday of each month free with reservation; advance booking via brerabooking.org.
quote: Grande Brera Ticket (combined access): Full price: €20.00 Reduced (ages 18-25): €4.00 [...] Free admission with reservations every first Sunday of the month

claim: Pinacoteca di Brera open Tuesday-Sunday 8:30-19:15 (last entry 18:00); closed Mondays, May 1, Dec 25, Jan 1; plan 2-3 hours for the collection.
quote: Tuesday to Sunday: 8:30 to 19:15. Last entrance at 18:00. Closed every Monday, plus May 1, December 25, and January 1.

claim: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II was built 1865-1877 by architect Giuseppe Mengoni, named for Italy's first king Victor Emmanuel II; central glass dome ~37.5 m diameter, 17.10 m height; Italy's oldest active shopping arcade and direct progenitor of the modern mall.
quote: Built between 1865 and 1877 [...] Giuseppe Mengoni [...] The central glass dome measures around 37.5 m as internal diameter and 17.10 m in height [...] Italy's oldest active shopping arcade

claim: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II is free to enter as a public passage between Piazza del Duomo and Piazza della Scala; quietest on weekday mornings shortly after shops open; mosaic floor restored in 2017 and again in 2026.
quote: Entry to the Galleria itself is free, allowing anyone to admire its beauty. Weekends and late afternoons tend to be the busiest times. [...] The mosaic has been restored in 2017 and again in 2026.
